query: SELECT DISTINCT architect.id, architect.name, architect.gender FROM architect JOIN bridge ON architect.id = bridge.architect_id GROUP BY architect.id HAVING COUNT(bridge.id) = 2 UNION SELECT DISTINCT architect.id, architect.name, architect.gender FROM architect JOIN mill ON architect.id = mill.architect_id GROUP BY architect.id HAVING COUNT(mill.id) = 1
question: What are the ids, names and genders of the architects who built two bridges or one mill?

question: What are the distinct name of the mills built by the architects who have also built a bridge longer than 80 meters?
